text_block_list.text:
The day of the large-scale mock race meet,
aimed at improving the skills and motivation of the academy's Umamusume.
Symboli Rudolf approached the task as the person ultimately responsible for its management.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Morale is soaring sky-high, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun, do you see that?

Prompted by Symboli Rudolf, I looked at the track.
I could see the Umamusume participating in the joint training getting ready in their own ways.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just a mock race,
I won't lose to you, Spe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Me too!
I'm not planning on losing to El-chan or anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet, don't tell me you're chickening out
just 'cause of a crowd this big?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Don't be ridiculous!
I'm going to take number one out of all of them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has good eyes.
Harboring burning fighting spirits and dazzling dreams in their hearts.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...I always wish for that brilliance
to run toward a bright future."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, today, as the student council president of this academy,
I wish to inspire and encourage them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Regarding this matter, as one who walks this path with me,
I would like to hear your opinion."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In order to help everyone push forward on their own paths,
what should I do—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh—
A foolish question, was it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We are Umamusume who race on the turf.
From the very beginning, we prove who we are to the world by running.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Then with this run of mine,
I too shall embody the state of single-minded devotion to the skies.
Symboli Rudolf showcased an overwhelming run in the first mock race, sending the crowd into an uproar.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I-Incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"This is outta hand—
but damn, it's such an exciting run...!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Once again, I thank you all
for gathering on this day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let us continue to hone our skills together,
pushing each other higher toward our respective dreams.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"As an Umamusume
running in the very same Twinkle Series!"
Symboli Rudolf's dignified presence ignited a newfound passion within all the gathered Umamusume.

She seems to have fulfilled her duty today
as an exemplar for everyone here.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Ideals can never begin without being spoken.
By giving voice to them, they become a steadfast guide.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Then I, too, shall put into words before them
the future we must strive for.

After Symboli Rudolf gave her opening remarks
and important notices for the mock race meet—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Lastly—
I want everyone to engrave this into your hearts once more."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: We each run, holding onto something we refuse to surrender.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"What each and every one of you harbors within right now.
Hope. Craving. Longing. Or something akin to that."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Each and every one of them is equally precious.
And running while carrying all of them—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: To give dreams to the people.
Symboli Rudolf's voice resonated loud and clear across the track.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: With our running, we'll bring dreams to—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu...
I'm getting all fired up, yes I am-deeesu!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I thank you for gathering on this very day.
Compete, elevate one another, and build our foundation."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"The glorious dream and future that we run and paint—
let this be its foundation!"

As a presence who guides those here,
she seems to have shown them the future to strive for.
